extensionAttribute.description: Estimated minutes of battery runtime remaining, or N/A on desktops. Apple reports 0 while still calculating after a wake or power-source change.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Battery Time Remaining Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon # Reads the TimeRemaining property from the AppleSmartBattery IOKit class. # Returns "N/A" on Macs without a battery (desktops).
value=$(/usr/sbin/ioreg -r -c AppleSmartBattery 2>/dev/null \ | /usr/bin/awk -F'= ' '/"TimeRemaining" =/ { gsub(/^[ "]+|[ "]+$/, "", $2); print $2; exit }')
echo "<result>${value:-N/A}</result>"
